{{Short description|English biennial mathematics award}}
{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}}

The '''David Crighton Medal''' is a biennial prize established in 2002 by the [[Institute of Mathematics and its Applications]] (IMA) and the [[London Mathematical Society]] (LMS) for "services both to mathematics and to the mathematical community". The holders are usually fellows of both the IMA and LMS.<ref name="IMA" /><ref>{{Cite web |title=David Crighton Medal {{!}} London Mathematical Society |url=https://www.lms.ac.uk/prizes/david-crighton-medal |access-date=2025-08-13 |website=www.lms.ac.uk}}</ref>

The award is issued on odd-numbered years, with its partner IMA-LMS prize, the [[Christopher Zeeman Medal]], issued on even-numbered years.<ref>{{Cite web |title=IMA-LMS Prizes {{!}} London Mathematical Society |url=https://www.lms.ac.uk/prizes/ima-lms-prizes |access-date=2025-08-13 |website=www.lms.ac.uk}}</ref>

== Rationale ==
The medal was first awarded in 2003 and was established in memory of [[David Crighton]] FRS (1942–2000) "for services both to mathematics and to the mathematical community".<ref name="IMA">{{cite web |title=David Crighton Medal |url=https://ima.org.uk/awards-medals/david-crighton-medal/ |accessdate=2025-08-13 |publisher=[[Institute of Mathematics and its Applications]] |location=UK}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Lang |first=Stacie |date=2023-08-16 |title=Professor Alison Etheridge FRS OBE is awarded 2023 IMA-LMS David Crighton Medal |url=https://ima.org.uk/22546/professor-alison-etheridge-frs-obe-is-awarded-2023-ima-lms-david-crighton-medal/ |access-date=2025-08-13 |website=IMA |language=en-GB}}</ref>

== Prize holders list ==
Source: [https://ima.org.uk/awards-medals/david-crighton-medal/ Institute of Mathematics and its Applications]

* 2003 [[John M. Ball|Sir John Ball]], FRS
* 2006 [[Christopher Zeeman|Sir Christopher Zeeman]], FRS
* 2009 [[Keith Moffatt]], FRS
* 2012 [[Arieh Iserles]] and [[Peter M. Neumann]], OBE
* 2015 [[Frank Kelly (mathematician)|Frank Kelly]], FRS CBE
* 2017 [[David Abrahams (mathematician)|I. David Abrahams]]
* 2019 Ken Brown, FRSE CBE
* 2021 [[Caroline Series]], FRS
* 2023 [[Alison Etheridge]], FRS OBE
* 2025 [[Alain Goriely]], FRS<ref>{{Cite web |last=Lang |first=Stacie |date=2025-07-30 |title=Professor Alain Goriely is awarded 2025 IMA-LMS David Crighton Medal |url=https://ima.org.uk/26907/professor-alain-goriely-is-awarded-2025-ima-lms-david-crighton-medal/ |access-date=2025-08-13 |website=IMA |language=en-GB}}</ref>
